title: HR Generalist
description: We are looking for an HR Generalist to run day-to-day people operations for a 150-person company. You will own recruitment coordination, onboarding, HRIS administration, payroll inputs, and employee engagement programmes, and support managers on policy and compliance questions.
requirements: 3+ years in an HR generalist or people operations role. Hands-on recruitment coordination and structured onboarding. Experience administering an HRIS. Monthly payroll input preparation. Working knowledge of Indian labour compliance. Strong interpersonal and written communication skills.
requiredEducation: Bachelor degree in human resources, business administration, or related field
